name: browse-bridge
description: Shared-tab browser control for Cursor via Browse Bridge MCP: observe, click, type, navigate, and screenshot tabs the user has Enabled. Requires the Browse Bridge Chrome extension and a Browse Bridge API key.

BROWSEBRIDGE_API_KEY.title: Browse Bridge API key
BROWSEBRIDGE_API_KEY.description: Create a key in the Browse Bridge dashboard (Connections). Starts with bbk_. Never commit this value.
